Can you add to the Redfish.md ?

Done. Added LifeTime/CorrectableECCErrorCount and LifeTime/UncorrectableECCErrorCount to the existing MemoryMetrics section in docs/Redfish.md.

See PS4:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/4/docs/Redfish.md
Please also add MemoryMetrics URI in Redfish.md
Done
Looks like this is mistake since MemoryMetrics URI doesn't exist on master. Please remove if so.

Fixed. Replaced with the two properties actually supported: LifeTime/CorrectableECCErrorCount, LifeTime/UncorrectableECCErrorCount.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/docs/Redfish.md#1085
For error other than EBADR we shold do messages::internalError. See memory.hpp file.

Errors other than EBADR log and call messages::internalError; EBADR returns silently.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/redfish-core/lib/memory_metrics.hpp#37
Shouldn't we check and not populated the redfish properties for default values?

Each property has its own nullptr guard:
- ceCount guard: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/redfish-core/lib/memory_metrics.hpp#59
- ueCount guard: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/redfish-core/lib/memory_metrics.hpp#65
When `unpackPropertiesNoThrow` leaves a pointer as null (property absent from the D-Bus reply or type mismatch), the corresponding Redfish field is skipped — no default 0 is exposed.

Both properties come from the same `xyz.openbmc_project.Memory.MemoryECC` interface, so in the common cases either both are present (populated) or both are absent. The both-absent case is actually caught earlier by the EBADR branch at https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/redfish-core/lib/memory_metrics.hpp#37 before reaching here. Partial presence would only happen if a producer registered the interface but omitted one property, which the per-property guards (https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/redfish-core/lib/memory_metrics.hpp#59, https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/redfish-core/lib/memory_metrics.hpp#65) still handle safely.
Remove this debug log.

Removed. The getMemoryMetricsECCData() function that held this log was folded into the callback chain; the log was dropped with it.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/redfish-core/lib/memory_metrics.hpp
We should log error and return messages::internalError if multiple services are found.

Switched to getDbusObject; object.size() != 1 logs and returns internalError.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/redfish-core/lib/memory_metrics.hpp#87
nit: this doesn't need to be separate function in my opinion.

Resolution uses the shared getValidDimmPath helper directly; no custom subtree function.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/redfish-core/lib/memory_metrics.hpp#179
Remove this debug log.

Removed. The whole getMemoryObject() function (which held this log) was removed, replaced by a call to the shared getValidDimmPath.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/redfish-core/lib/memory_metrics.hpp
This comment seems redundant because it doesn’t add anything beyond what can already be inferred from the function parameter names. Same applies to other comments in this file.

Removed all function-level doxygen blocks; only the SPDX header is kept.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/redfish-core/lib/memory_metrics.hpp
nit: this doesn't need to be separate function in my opinion.

handleMemoryMetricsGet does the work directly; no intermediate wrapper.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/redfish-core/lib/memory_metrics.hpp#143
use std::format.

Name uses std::format("{} Memory Metrics", memoryId).
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/redfish-core/lib/memory_metrics.hpp#177
Can't we use `getValidDimmPath` instead?

Yes. handleMemoryMetricsGet calls getValidDimmPath to resolve the inventory path, then getDbusObject to locate the MemoryECC service.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/redfish-core/lib/memory_metrics.hpp#179

Looks like `getValidDimmPath` function doesn't return service of the object path. Let's not use it then to avoid multiple DBus calls. Please use plain getSubTree and call getMemoryMetricsECCData if interface xyz.openbmc_project.Memory.MemoryECC is found.
Shouldn't we add property in Memory URI that points to MemoryMetrics URI?

Added. afterGetDimmData in memory.hpp sets jsonValue["Metrics"]["@odata.id"] to the MemoryMetrics URI, so clients can navigate from Memory to Metrics.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/12/redfish-core/lib/memory.hpp#811
Add this property to docs/Redfish.md.

Done. Added `Metrics` under the Memory section in docs/Redfish.md.

https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/15/docs/Redfish.md#1073
This is not fixed.
Done in PS18. Sorry for push mistake.

Done. Use getSubTree filtered by xyz.openbmc_project.Memory.MemoryECC to get path and service in one DBus call, then call getAllProperties for the ECC counts. The getMemoryMetricsECCData wrapper was already removed in PS12 and inlined into getAllProperties.

Done in PS18. Sorry for push mistake.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87169/18/redfish-core/lib/memory_metrics.hpp#183
nit: Could we add `bmcweb:` ?
Rename to Memory, done, thanks
Does all memory have metrics or does this link need to be conditional on the interface being found on dbus?  See comment on line 814 above.

Done, thanks. The Metrics link is now emitted only when the Dimm exposes xyz.openbmc_project.Memory.MemoryECC, matching the merged Processor EnvironmentMetrics link (gated on Control.Power.Cap). Without ECC the MemoryMetrics GET returns resourceNotFound, so it is no longer advertised.
